big-bear.name: Big Bear CasaOS App Store
big-bear.summary: A community app collection from Big Bear and friends.
big-bear.description: The Big Bear app store is independently maintained by BigBearTechWorld and the BigBearCommunity for ZimaOS and CasaOS. ZimaOS uses the native JSON source published from the repository's gh-pages branch and listed in the ZimaOS documentation. CasaOS uses the separate master-branch ZIP archive.

linuxserver.name: CasaOS-LinuxServer-AppStore
linuxserver.summary: LinuxServer.io apps for ZimaOS and CasaOS, with separate platform sources.
linuxserver.description: A community app store containing over 100 LinuxServer.io images. Upstream provides a JSON store manifest for ZimaOS and a separate ZIP source for CasaOS. Choose the source for your system.

appstore-play.name: CasaOS-AppStore-Play
appstore-play.summary: Chinese community apps for ZimaOS and CasaOS, plus an ARMv7 CasaOS source.
appstore-play.description: A community app store focused on Chinese applications, including Thunder, Qinglong, and VerySync. ZimaOS uses the native JSON source listed in the ZimaOS documentation; CasaOS uses separate ZIP sources. Applications use the :latest tag. The ARMv7 CasaOS source is intended for Raspberry Pi 2, OneCloud, and similar devices.

coolstore.name: CasaOS-Coolstore
coolstore.summary: A fresh collection of cool apps for your personal cloud.
coolstore.description: Another community-built CasaOS app store, bringing together a collection of cool applications to explore on your device.

edge.name: CasaOS (Edge) AppStore
edge.summary: A community fork of the official store with updated versions.
edge.description: An archived community fork of the official CasaOS app store that offered updated application versions. Upstream now directs users to the official CasaOS AppStore repository.

home-automation.name: CasaOS HomeAutomation AppStore
home-automation.summary: Useful tools for a more connected home, and a little more.
home-automation.description: A CasaOS app store containing useful applications for home automation and other tasks. Bring more of your connected home tools together on your own device.

tmc.name: TMC Community App Store
tmc.summary: A community-driven collection, open to your contributions.
tmc.description: An independent, community-driven app store curated by TMC (mariosemes), open to contributions from anyone. Explore the applications brought together by its community.

pentest-docker.name: CasaOS Pentest-Docker AppStore
pentest-docker.summary: A dedicated collection of penetration testing tools.
pentest-docker.description: Pentest-Docker is a third-party CasaOS app store containing penetration testing tool applications.

generative-ai-workbench.name: JSDs Generative AI Workbench
generative-ai-workbench.summary: An AI workbench for digital artisans and creative studios.
generative-ai-workbench.description: The Foundry Workbench brings together generative AI applications and tools for digital artisans and studios. Upstream develops these apps on ZimaOS and declares CasaOS compatibility. This listing records the CasaOS ZIP source; a native ZimaOS JSON manifest has not been verified. A suitable GPU and application-specific setup may be required.

lintuxer.name: Lintuxer Apps
lintuxer.summary: Community apps for ZimaOS with documented verification notes.
lintuxer.description: A community app store for ZimaOS, published as a native v2 JSON source and listed in the ZimaOS documentation. The maintainer documents per-app checks, including tested versions and setup notes. Review each application's notes for its device and configuration requirements.
